long_biography.plain_text:
UniPegaso gave Danilo Iervolino a scalable answer to Italy's new framework for online universities. After developing distance-learning master's programmes at the University of Salerno, he studied the University of Phoenix model in the United States. He combined digital delivery with a nationwide network of examination and learning centres, bringing degree courses to working adults and other underserved students.

Multiversity grew further by adding Universitas Mercatorum and investing in technology, teaching staff and physical infrastructure. Iervolino first sold half the group to CVC, then exited completely in 2021 after the platform had become one of Europe's largest online-education businesses. He declined a continuing chairmanship, leaving the education group under CVC's ownership.

proposed_details.existing_value:
The sale of the inaugural Columbus Atlantique 47 motor yacht was announced by Columbus Yachts, a division of Palumbo Superyachts, in November 2021. The project was specifically initiated for a particular client.

On March 15, 2023, the Italian newspaper Corriere Della Sera published an article providing comprehensive details about the transaction. The yacht was sold for €17,500,000 excluding VAT, with an additional €220,000 allocated for optional features. The anticipated delivery date is January 15, 2024, and an initial installment of €2.1 million was paid on December 16, 2021. The article also discloses that the buyer of the yacht is an Italian entrepreneur named Danilo Iervolino.

Despite being just 44 years old, Mr. Iervolino has already amassed a considerable fortune. In October 2021, he sold his remaining 50% stake in Pegaso University, his online education company, to the investment fund CVC for approximately €1.1 billion. This amount far exceeded the €225 million he earned from selling the first 50% of the company to CVC in 2019. Mr. Iervolino founded Pegaso at the remarkable age of 18 in 2006.

Following the sale of his company, Mr. Iervolino has remained active in various ventures. He acquired the football club U.S. Salernitana 1919 based in Salerno and now holds the position of President, as evidenced by his Instagram account.

Additionally, Mr. Iervolino purchased BFC Media, an Italian publishing company responsible for Forbes Italia and the magazine L'Espresso. Forbes Italia estimated his net worth to be €1.1 billion as of August 2022.

uncertainties.detail: Forbes reported in 2023 that most of Iervolino's post-sale wealth remained in cash and stocks, alongside technology, media, property and football investments. Its March 2026 profile continues to describe direct startup and fund investing, but no current audited personal portfolio is public. Finance & Investments is therefore used at high rather than very-high confidence, without treating the visible sports or media companies as the source of his fortune.

Forbes describes Iervolino as born in Palma Campania, while a published first-person profile quotes him saying he was born in Naples and always lived in Palma Campania. The immutable record already supplies Italy as birth country and the full birth date, but the municipality conflict prevents a place-of-birth proposal.

Forbes calls the fortune self-made and documents Iervolino's creation and growth of Pegaso. It also establishes that his father ran private schools, a professor who knew his father introduced him to distance-learning work, and his brothers initially held a minority interest that he later bought. These facts support an advantaged start but not inheritance of the principal education group.

Football ownership and BFC AI Media are documented post-sale investments. Because club ownership, team performance, publication portfolios and executive offices can change, the biographies describe them as later capital allocations and do not use current team status, a current percentage or a publication transaction as the central wealth mechanism.

The existing LinkedIn and Instagram URLs match the resolved person and are preserved. No distinct personal website, Facebook, X, YouTube or TikTok account met the cross-link standard. The dedicated Forbes profile, current BFC company domain and exact Wikipedia article are proposed under their separate supported types.

The existing biography was replaced because it was led by current-vessel facts and included an incorrect founding age, point-in-time prices, a net-worth estimate and transient sports and media claims.
